text: Commander Marone Ales is a Breton commander of the Lion Guard in . He may be found in the Lion Guard Redoubt in Glenumbra, where he is waiting for the Vestige.
Coldharbour Sentinels are creatures that appears in . There are three of them scattered around Coldharbour, and are used by Molag Bal to watch over his domain.
Commodore Elpion is an Altmer at the Temple of the Crescent Moon, mostly sitting behind his map of Khenarthi's Roost. He thinks that the situation on the island is less than ideal.
Comira is a Redguard chef working at The Drowsy Owl in the city of Hallin's Stand.
Commander Taldyn is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Tal'Deic Fortress, Deshaan.
Coinclerk Camarelur is an Altmer banker at the Skywatch Coinhouse in the city of Skywatch.
Coinclerk Endalle is an Altmer banker residing in the city of Skywatch.
Clovis Armene is a Breton residing in the town of Dragonstar.
Cloud Snout is a Khajiit working at the Great Tree Stables in Elden Root.
Clovis Lan is a Breton bard residing in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Colane Sorick is a Breton soldier found in Shornhelm, outside of the resident Mages Guild branch.
Colanwe is an angry spirit in that is found in the ruins of Tanzelwil.
Colbois Benichou is a Breton refugee who resides in Camp Tamrith, Rivenspire.
Coletta is a Breton who may be found at the Thizzrini Arena in Reaper's March.

Colonel Festius is an Imperial officer of the Legion of the West Weald. He is in charge of the forces assaulting Vinedusk Village. He is found inside Nendaer's Tomb, accompanied by his aides, Crispus and Sabina.
Colwyn San is a Breton found in Koeglin Village. He can be found on The Tava's Bounty. He has no unique dialogue.
Commander Ahla is a Redguard member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She may be found at the Bangkorai Garrison, which she commands.
Commander Amuur is the leader of the Dominion forces who took over Farwatch Tower.
Commander Attius is an Imperial officer in charge of Seventh Legion's troops occupying the Bangkorai Garrison.
Commander Derre is a Breton commander of the Lion Guard. He is the leader of the division hiding in The Lion's Den in The Rift.
Commander Gerieux is a Breton member of the Knights of the Flame guarding the entrance to the Alcaire Castle.
Commander Jano is an Imperial member of the Gold Coast Mercenaries. He is found at their camp in the Four Quarry Islet.
Commander Concordia is an Imperial member of the Gold Coast Mercenaries. She is found at their camp in the Four Quarry Islet.

Commander Pyline is the commander of House Montclair's troops. She is typically found coordinating the troops outside of Northpoint, south of Dorell Farmhouse. She is also the author of the note Orders from Commander Pyline.
Commander Renli is a soldier of House Hlaalu tracking the origins of the plague in Narsis.
Commander Tacita is an Imperial member of the Gold Coast Mercenaries. She is found at their camp in the Four Quarry Islet.
Commander Thandon is a Dunmer member of the Maulborn cult. He is found in their camp outside Narsis.
Commander Yjarnn is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed at Fort Amol.
Commodore Ohmanil is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers found on Tempest Island. He is fought as a miniboss after Stormfist, and appears with many generic Sea Vipers.
Condalin is the Altmer forgemaster of Mathiisen, Auridon. He has ties with the Veiled Heritance.
Comes-When-Called is a pony guar in that resides in The Gray Mire, Grahtwood. It stays in a croft with two other guars, Endless-Belly and bantam guar Small-One.
Commoner is a character residing in the city of Davon's Watch. He is seen mourning over a deceased woman and will only mutter generic responses when spoken to.

Commander Reliana is a Breton who was a Knight of the Dragon during the First Era. Her mentor was Lord Trystan, whom she also served as an assistant to. She killed General Mercedene, one of the most famed and fierce Forsworn in history.
The Company Guard is an Imperial Legion soldier under the employment of the East Empire Company. He can be found in the East Empire Company Hall in Ebonheart.

Colaadron is a Maormer outlaw found in the Bazaar District of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. He can be found walking between the Alchemy Station beside Salvilo's Wonderful Potions and The Sorcerer's Safeguard.
Comilla Callonus is an Imperial found in the audience hall of the castle in Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Commander Pelletus, or Watch Commander Pelletus, is an Imperial in charge of the local watch in the Jarol Estate.
College Guard is a Nord Sorcerer. He is an unused Character. He wears a set of Master Robes of Destruction, and a pair of boots.
Colaagwen is an Altmer commoner in who is found fishing at the docks in Bleakrock Village.
Colinra is an Altmer noble wandering about inside the Vulkhel Guard Manor & Treasury in Vulkhel Guard. She has no unique dialogue.
Colwyn Frinck is a Breton member of the Evermore City Guard. He is part of the squad sent to investigate the troubles of Murcien's Hamlet.
Codaermet the Wicked is a Dremora found in the Isle of Torment. She holds the Key of Discord, which is required to seal the tear in Moonhenge. She has a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Colotarion is an Altmer battleground supplies merchant residing in Vivec City. He is the proprietor of Gladiator Trading Goods, found in the Gladiator's Quarters in the south of the city.
Colinyarion is an Altmer laborer located outside the Foyada Quarry.
Companion Healer is a generic Healer residing in several locations in .
Commander Prossos was a Commander of the Imperial Legion during Titus Mede I's reign. He commanded 500 men during the Siege of the Imperial City.

Concerned Citizen is a farmer living in Wayrest. She is encountered trying to close the city gates so the corsairs won't get inside the city. After that, she will ask the agent to rescue her "baby," who she left behind the gates.

Concordia Mercius is an Imperial member of the Cyrodilic Collections who can be found in either Davon's Watch, Daggerfall, or Vulkhel Guard, depending on which alliance the Vestige joined. She has a sister, Famia Mercius.
Commander Marcus Scipio is a hostile Imperial found in Castle Kvatch in Kvatch. Fortunata ap Dugal paid the Dark Brotherhood to kill him to frighten Count Carolus.

Commander Rufus is Vernons commanding officer, and together the two of them pushed back the Daedra attacking Bruma. They were separated during their retreat. He was saved by the Champion of Cyrodiil, who was sent by Vernon.

Coaxer Veran is a Dunmer member of the Sixth House. She can be found in the western part of the Forgotten Depths of the Forgotten Wastes. Together with Castigator Athin and Confessor Dradas, they are considered a boss of the dungeon.
Colossal Coral Crabs are creatures that appear in . They are a bigger variant of coral crabs, differing in size and the corals on their back.
Contumeliorus Florius is an Imperial mage and an Evoker of the Mages Guild who offers recharging services at the Chorrol Guild Hall.
Constance Michel is an Imperial who works at Honorhall Orphanage, in Riften, with Grelod the Kind. She wears a belted tunic and boots.
Constans Atrius is an Imperial noble and Carnius Magius' assistant.
Conjurer Grahla is an Orsimer in the camp on the Glenumbra Moors, Glenumbra, in . She can later be found in Camlorn.
Connalenwe is an Altmer mystic residing in Elden Root, Grahtwood.

Constable Ketrique is a Breton who resides in the shanty town of Dreughside, in the region of Stormhaven. She is looking out for reinforcements to help in the elimination of the dreugh that have taken over Dreughside.
Condier Ergend is a Breton residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. He is found in the Wayrest Regiment's Camp just outside the northern gates of the town.
Conjures-with-Toes is an Argonian residing in the Dormitory in Shad Astula.
Connor the Wild-Eyed is a Nord laborer found in Helena's Home. He has no unique dialogue.
Connynque is an Altmer fence who can be found at the outlaws refuge underneath Vulkhel Guard.

Constable Agazu is an Orsimer and the former leader of the Fell's Run Guard. After the arrival of a new guardsman who bribed the local mayor to take her position, she became exiled to the rest of the village, and thus became a regular patron at the town's inn.
Constable Bronorr is a Nord member of the Riften City Guard. He is currently investigating the recent crimes that occurred at the marketplace.
Constable Cebroon is an Altmer noble of the Skywatch city guard in who inspects new visitors crossing the main gate.
Constable Darrel Avagour is a Breton member of the Wind Keep Town Guard.
Constable Ebarah is a Redguard member of the Kozanset City Guard.
Constable Gerrunn is a Nord member of the Ivarstead Town Guard.
Constable Luc is a member of the Lion Guard part of the investigation team looking into the problems occurring in Eagle's Brook.
Constable Ysabel Jeuneau is a Breton member of the Knights of the Flame posted in Wind Keep.
Cooks-the-Meat is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall of Windhelm.
Copper Dariah is a Redguard and the leader of the Ring of Daggers, the secret intelligence network of the Daggerfall Covenant.
Coppermane is a Khajiit who resides in the city of Dune in Reaper's March.
Coquina Plouff is a Breton chef who works at the Dead Wolf Inn, in the city of Shornhelm, Rivenspire.
Conjurer Squan is an Altmer mage found inside the ruins of Shada's Tear.
Contar Regilus is an Imperial found in the audience hall of the castle in Anvil. He cannot be interacted with.
Conjurer Hrolda is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. She is part of Warlock Carindon's team which is tasked with exploring Selene's Web.
Constance Quarra is a Breton residing in the local guild hall of the Mages Guild in Marbruk, Greenshade. She is drunk most of the time.
Constable Baldan is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Constable Drados is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Conflagrator Llals is a member of the Sixth House in Kora-Dur.
Conservator Vinelore is a Altmer who can be found in Sil-Var-Woad, Summerset. She is a curator of the Royal Menagerie at Sil-Var-Woad.
Constantia Galena is an Imperial who appears in the Town. She is a long-time resident of the town, and knew the Fugitive from when they were first living there.

Conflagrator Llaals is a Dunmer member of the Sixth House. He can be found in the south-western part of Kora-Dur in the Fallen Wastes. Together with Mynar Igna, they are considered a boss of the dungeon.
Confused Lunatics are considerably high-level werewolves on the island of Solstheim. Confused Lunatics are one of many werewolf templates that can be encountered on Solstheim.
Craetia Jullalian is an Imperial Alchemist, and merchant in the Vivec City Mages Guild. She is an Alchemist, and thus has a wide range of ingredients and potions for sale.
Corrick Northwode is a poor Breton farmer who has recently lost his wife. He lives on the farmstead of Harm's Folly.

Corvus Umbranox was the Count of Anvil before he went missing ten years ago, due to the curse of the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal. Corvus Umbranox is the last known Gray Fox, Guildmaster of the Thieves Guild. He is also known as The Stranger when not wearing the cowl. Once the Thieves Guild questline is complete, he becomes Count of Anvil again.
Cosmus the Cheat is an Imperial beggar in Bravil. His bedroll is located just behind The Fair Deal. Cosmus is inflicted with the disease Chills.
Corpulus Vinius is an Imperial and the owner of The Winking Skeever in Solitude. He rents out beds for 10 and will buy and sell food.
Cosnach is a Breton who lives in the Warrens of Markarth. His cousin, Imedhnain, also lives in Markarth and works as an assistant at the Arnleif and Sons Trading Company.

Count Cirion was an Altmer noble who resided in the Shivering Isles. Cirion was the ruler of Vitharn until it fell to a group of invaders due to the incompetence of the defenders and Cirion's cowardice. Sheogorath cursed the ghosts of the inhabitants to re-live their last moments forever. His wife is Countess Cirion. The Hero can find Cirion's ghost in the ruins of Vitharn.

Corda was a former assassin of the Morag Tong at the end of the First Era. Corda was responsible for the death of Reman Cyrodiil III, for the execution of her sister, Rijja. Corda's actions had led to the end of the Reman Dynasty and the First Era.
Corky is a tame guar owned by Llovyn Andus, found outside Llovyn's Farmhouse in the Ascadian Isles region. He can be sold to Drulene Falen to obtain the money Llovyn owes.
Counts-His-Teeth is an Argonian soldier for the Ebonheart Pact.
Ylanie Bouchard is a Breton living in Betnikh. She is one of the characters found in King Renwic's vision.
Corporal Marent is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He is found looking out for something by one of the bridges in town.

Counselor Ruffe Montgren is a Breton living in Betnikh. He is one of the characters found in King Renwic's vision. When questioned by Warcaller Targoth, he first offered money, and then told him to kill Ylanie Bouchard instead of him, saying that she knows everything.
Corwin Rajida is a Redguard who is found in the Wyrd camp near Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. He is a refugee from Camlorn.
Crack-Nose is a Khajiit patron of the Five Claws Inn in Woodhearth.
Corporal Aldouin is a Breton located near Farwatch Tower, Glenumbra, in . He is found wounded and searching for his recruits.
Councilor Theodore is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra, in . He joins the resistance Tamien Sellan is organizing.
Councilor Donella is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She can be found in her house
Councilor Virgile is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. He is found in his house when the Vestige arrive.
Corbyn Rangouze is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He is found outside the Temple of the Divines. He is representing Stendarr.

Coventina Celata is an Imperial assassin in who is located in the Felsaad Coast region nearby Graring's House. She was ordered by Carnius Magius to go there and assassinate Graring for the Ancient Nordic Pick Axe.
Corporal Fairenwen is an Altmer residing in the city of Velyn Harbor.
Corentin Clavarie is a Breton residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth, seen standing near some crates at the north side of the marketplace,. He frequently speaks with Tips-the-Scales.
Corelanya is an enchanter member of the Mages Guild selling her wares at her stall, Enchantment Is No Joke, in the hall of Marbruk.
Corporal Adel is a Breton member of the Lion Guard found in their camp near the ruins of Dwynnarth, Glenumbra, in .
Corporal Bredrek is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. He is part of the forces helping the citizens of Riften recover from Sinmur's attack.
Corporal Seruli is a Dunmer soldier of House Hlaalu tracking the ones who caused the plague in Narsis.
Corwyn is a Breton and one of the few survivors of the Bloodfiend attack on Moira's Hope.
Councilor Ralden is a Dunmer and the head of House Hlaalu. He is found in his kinhouse in Narsis.

Count Hosni at-Tura is the Redguard proprietor of the At-Tura Estate and the leader of the group of smugglers known as the Midnight Union in the Second Era, who were taken as a neutral force in Stormhaven until the attack against Pariah Abbey. Hosni at-Tura is the son of Lord Rihad at-Tura and Lady Sirali at-Tura, well known as a strong, respected and even feared leader of the aforementioned mercenary group, responsible for stealing the Dream Shard from the Spirit Wardens. During Vaermina's plot to dominate Stormhaven and shatter the Daggerfall Covenant, the Count served as a key character to the Daedric Prince's plan. It was well known also about his romantic relation with Sister Safia, and
Countess Eselde Tamrith is one of the three nobles fighting for control of the kingdom of Rivenspire.
Countess Gisele Phien is a Breton noble partaking in the festivities happening at the At-Tura Estate.
Countess Ilise Manteau is the mayor of Wind Keep. After the death of her husband, she became the target of many suitors from all over Tamriel, one even coming as far as the Summerset Isles.
Counts-the-Clouds is an Argonian worshipper of the Tribunal, found outside the temple in Mournhold.
Coyne Berri is a Breton working on the newly installed guillotine in Wayrest.
Courier Rufinus is an Imperial member of the Gold Coast Mercenaries working as a courier on their behalf.

Cordius Pontifio is an Imperial and one of the three members of Empress Regent Clivia Tharn's Elite Guard. Him and his companions first appear friendly but laters turns hostile in the main library of the White-Gold Tower.
Councilor Itinia is an Imperial member of the Elder Council. She is found in each of the warring factions' camp inside the Imperial City Sewers.
Coyle is a Redguard gypsy found in a camp north of Stros M'kai with his mother, Saban.
Cornexius Cossus is an Imperial found in the city of Orsinium. He is impossible to interact with.
Corporal Lugrots is an Orsimer found outside Frostbreak Fortress in Wrothgar.
Coristir is an Altmer soul shriven found in Coldharbour. He is a member of the Veiled Heritance and serves High Kinlady Estre as her champion at the Cliffs of Failure.
Corporal Brelinith is a Bosmer and one of the few survivors of the initial Fist of Thalmor team that went into the Wilding Run to investigate a recent undead threat.

Cow Hand is an unused Nord in . He was supposed to make an appearance in the unused quest "CWMission08," a Civil War quest which was not implemented in the final version of the game. He wears a belted tunic, a pair of boots and a hat.
Corintthac the Abomination is a Reachman member of the Winterborn Clan and a world boss. He is found at The Accursed Nursery, where he is summoned after a few waves of his men are defeated.
Count Peverel Stemuseph is a Breton noble found at the Stonetooth Fortress.
Countess Viatrix Celata is a Breton noblewoman. She has a fondness for acquiring and owning stolen items and thus is a regular patron of the Thieves Guild.
Courier Benas is an Argonian messenger of the Ebonheart Pact in who resides at the Bal Foyen Dockyards after "Breaking the Tide."
Corrupt Agent is a Nord contractor in who resides in the Penitus Oculatus Outpost in Dragon Bridge.
Court Magister is a Crow found in the Crow's Wood. Court Magister is a member of Blackfeather Court.
Corporal Loddvaar is a Nord officer of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed at their camp in Vernim Woods.
Corirmorion is an Altmer located east of the Foyada Quarry ferrying stone from Foyada Quarry to Vivec. He cannot be interacted with.
Councilor Eris Releth is a Dunmer located in Balmora, in . He is a councilor of House Redoran, ruling out of the city-state of Balmora. Recently, Eris' daughter, Veya Releth has gone missing.
Corporal Lliran is a Dunmer residing in Balmora, in Vvardenfell. He can be seen ordering several House Redoran Soldiers to find Veya Releth outside the family kinhouse. He cannot be interacted with.
Councilor Dolvara is a Dunmer councilor of House Redoran, residing in Arenim Manor on Vvardenfell.
Covenant Storm Mage is a generic character residing in multiple locations. They are members of the Daggerfall Covenant.
Corynne Madier is a Breton laborer found at the Seaside Sanctuary after the Sea Vipers are driven out. She has no unique dialogue.
Corporal Darvel is a Dunmer member of House Redoran, and a member of Vatola Telem's team. He can be seen impaled on a pike behind one of the buildings at Hlormaren.
The Court Healer is an Imperial healer who appears after the completion of "Prince of Madness."
Corruption of Water is a wraith located at the Wyrd Tree, Glenumbra, in .
Cororrond is an Altmer commoner found on the street outside of Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Corunorion is an Altmer who can be found in the fields south of the Ceporah Tower in Artaeum. He cannot be interacted with.
Corim Ashlen is a character in . He is the Loremaster of the Mages Guild in Lillandril. He shares the same appearance as other generic members of the guild.

Corrupted Guardians are hostile characters found in Spindleclutch I in Glenumbra. They are members of the Fighters Guild accompanying Praxin Douare on an expedition into the cave, who were driven insane by strange whispers.

Corrupted Evokers are hostile characters found in Spindleclutch I in Glenumbra. They are members of the Fighters Guild accompanying Praxin Douare on an expedition into the cave, who were driven insane by strange whispers.

Corrupted Infantry are hostile characters found in Spindleclutch I in Glenumbra. They are members of the Fighters Guild accompanying Praxin Douare on an expedition into the cave, who were driven insane by strange whispers.

Corrupted Knights are hostile characters found in Spindleclutch I in Glenumbra. They are members of the Fighters Guild accompanying Praxin Douare on an expedition into the cave, who were driven insane by strange whispers.
Corloius Vania is an Imperial member of the Shields of Senchal in .
Corrupted Stonelore Rockseers are generic hostile Breton former members of the Stonelore Circle that were corrupted by the Eldertide Circle in .
Count Damard Dufort, also known as The Ascendant Magus, is a Breton in and is the secondary antagonist of .
Councilor Erthus Vandacia is an Imperial nobleman and former member of the Elder Council. He secretly serves as the High Priest of the Order of the Waking Flame, a cult devoted to Mehrunes Dagon.
Verandis Ravenwatch is an Altmer Vampire, one of the counts of Rivenspire, the ruler of Crestshade, and Lord of Ravenwatch Castle.
Creeper is a unique Scamp merchant residing in Ghorak Manor in Caldera.
Crassius Curio is an Imperial nobleman in the city of Vivec City, serving as a Councilor for House Hlaalu. He also writes adult novels.
Crottus Cedus is a hostile Imperial agent and smuggler trainer who resides in smuggler's cave of Shurinbaal. He also offers training, if the Nerevarine can manage to speak with him.
Cristus Lync is a Nord smuggler who resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Arkngthand.
Crantius Colto is a character in the book The Lusty Argonian Maid, A Song and its sequels. In books, he uses a wide variety of euphemisms to attempt to seduce the Argonian maid, Lifts-Her-Tail.
Crazy-Legs Arantamo is a Dunmer Savant, and the second-in-command of the Vivec City Thieves Guild.

The Crazed Dog is a creature encountered in that can be found in the Lighthouse cellar in Anvil. He belongs to Mathieu Bellamont. The dog is aggressive when his master's home is approached. He will attack the Hero on sight.
Crescius Caerellius is an elderly Imperial miner on Solstheim.

Crafty Lerisa is a Breton pirate and captain of the Maiden, who is stranded on the island of Stros M'Kai. She is found alongside her pet monkey, Howler. Lerisa is one of three characters that Captain Kaleen requests to help her on a heist she has planned. She will help if the Vestige helps her crew mates. She can later be found on Kaleen's ship in Wayrest Docks along with part of her crew. If the Vestige interacts with her, they will know what she has been up to since leaving Betnikh and Stros M'Kai.
Crenard Dortene is an Breton residing in Saintsport, Stros M'Kai. He is one of Crafty Lerisa's crew and has been captured by the Sea Drakes.
Cristoph Lamont is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found in the market, near one of the stands. He plays an important role in the Blood and the Crescent Moon.
Crazy Sebastien is a Breton member of the Daggerfall Covenant and the Lion Guard. He is a boss in The Lion's Den, a public dungeon.
Crier Martine is a Breton town crier residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She shouts news and warnings to all citizens about what is going on in and near town.
Crito Olcinius is an Imperial priest and member of the Imperial Cult who resides in the Imperial Cult Services at the Royal Palace of Mournhold.
Crendal is a Breton located outside the Draggin Tale Inn, and is always drunk and making fun of people.
Crispus is an Imperial member of the Legion fo the West Weald. He is found alongside his commanding officer, Colonel Festius, within Nendaer's Tomb in Vinedusk Village.
Crazy Eye is a Khajiit member of the Baandari Clan. She is found at their camp at the Martyr's Crossing in Bangkorai.
Croak Throat is a Khajiit who resides in the town of S'ren-ja.
Crown Gentleman is a Redguard found in the Alik'r Desert city of Bergama.

Crispinus Platorius is an Imperial guard protecting the priests of Mara found near Fort Sphinxmoth. After several relics were stolen by bandits, he and some of his fellow guards followed them to their base in the ruined fort.
Crematorial Guard is a creature that appears in the Imperial City and the region of Wrothgar.
Crew Chief Hondulf is a male character residing in Shulk Ore Mine.
The Crosstree Archer is a generic Archer residing in . They are a member of the Crosstree Bandits. They are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a Disguise is worn.
The Crosstree Bravo is a generic Archer residing in . They are a member of the Crosstree Bandits. They are hostile towards the Vestige, unless a Disguise is worn.
The Cragkin Hunter is an enemy in . They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and attack on sight.
The Cragkin Witch is an enemy in . They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and attack on sight.
Crazed Hermit is a Nord located at the Crazed Hermit's Cabin, Western Skyrim, in . He can be found stabbing a dead body on the ground outside and is always hostile. He has no unique dialogue.

Cuhlecain, also known as Emperor Zero, was a petty king of the Colovian Estates becoming the king of Falkreath in the late-Second Era. He appointed Tiber Septim, also known as Hjalti Early-Beard or Talos, as the general of his armies.
Cunius Pelelius is an Imperial Agent who resides in Caldera. He is a lawman of House Hlaalu.
Cun is a Bosmer Sharpshooter living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni, and guards Trerayna Dalen.

Crulius Pontanian is an Imperial Enchanter and Acolyte-ranked member of the Imperial Cult at the Moonmoth Legion Fort. He offers enchanting services and has a variety of magical items and scrolls for sale.
Curtis is an unused Redguard commoner who is listed in in the Construction Set, though he does not appear in the game.
CuSith is a unique death hound found staying with the Volkihar Clan inside Castle Volkihar. Like Garmr, he can become a follower if the Dragonborn has chosen to become a Vampire Lord.
Cumanya is an Altmer sorcereress found inside Dubdilla, the cave where she lives alone. She will be friendly to the Nerevarine.
Cuunel is a Bosmer monk, and a member of House Telvanni residing in Sulipund.

Curvanen is an Altmer ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" quest has been completed, and the ghosts have returned to the temple. He does not have any dialogue.

Curano was an Ayleid hero who was tasked by the High King of Delodiil with assembling a squad of heroes to destroy Abagarlas and hide the Prismatic Crystal. She recounted her experience in her journal.

Crypt Caretaker is a character in . He can be found in the Crypt of Hearts. He is trapped in the Crypt by undead summoned by Pergan Asuul, and only manages to escape with the help of the Soul of Conflict.
Crown Warden Seral is a Redguard member of The Crowns who can be found outside A'tor's Oasis in Bergama.
Culanwe is a priestess of Azura who was captured and brought to Coldharbour by Molag Bal.
Culdandil is a Altmer member of the Mages Guild found in the guildhall of Velyn Harbor.
Curate Brethis is a Dunmer and the leader of the priests found in Iliath Temple.
Curime is an Altmer member of the First Auridon Marines and part of the force attempting to retake Firsthold from High Kinlady Estre and her Daedra.

Curinure is an Altmer recruiter for the Mages Guild found in the hall in Vulkhel Guard. He may also be located in the guildhall in the Saint Delyn Waistworks of Vivec City, the guildhall in Shimmerene, the guildhall in Rimmen and outside the Solitude Mages Guild in Solitude.
Curnard the Generous is the Breton leader of the bandits occupying Viridian Watch. He is the author of his journal and the Bjoulsae Boys Charter.
Cwynoniel is a Bosmer farmer, and patron of the Market-Side Meadery in the city of Skywatch, Auridon.
Cumberland is a monkey found in Malabal Tor. He is a performer for the Dancing Scrib, a troupe of travelling entertainers run by Elandora.
Crusader Dalamar is a Redguard that can be found at the Skyreach Catacombs in Craglorn, Hammerfell.
Cuinur of Cloudrest is an Altmer patron of The Bay Tar's Mess, one of the two inns located in Evermore.
Curtaarimon is an Altmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion. He can be found at their camp at the Falinesti Winter Site in Grahtwood.
Crucible Guardian is a creature that appears in the Blessed Crucible in .
Cuilalme is an Altmer enchanter working at his stall, Fine Enchantments, in the Foundation's Embrace marketplace in Vivec City.
Curate Skaliz is a Dunmer member of the Nycotic Cult residing in Hlormaren Stronghold in Vvardenfell. He summons Skaafin Witchling during the fight.
Crucible Hunter is a generic Hunter residing in several locations in .
Cuisine Administrator is a Factotum chef residing in The Cloisters in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Cursed Scholar is a member of the Dro-m'Athra residing in Reaper's March.
Culuire is an Altmer servant found scrubbing the floor upstairs in Kinlady Avinisse's Mansion in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Cularime is an Altmer found outside of Nyderion's Boarding Home in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.

Cuileril is the Altmer innkeeper of the Anchors Aweigh Inn in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. Although he claims to be best friends with many non-Altmer, the only one he can name is his employee, Riharai.
Curandil is a Altmer commoner found in the Western Warehouse at the Sentinel Docks after the quest "Risen from the Depths."

Curate Sneg is a Dunmer cultist encountered inside the Ashurnibibi ruins in . He is the leader of the local group of Malacath Fanatics. Vaelin Oren, the Mouth of House Telvanni , hired the Morag Tong to kill him..
Curator Sarys is a Dunmer researcher of the Mages Guild found in the Daedric Ruins of Ramimilk, Vvardenfell, in . She has no unique dialogue and cannot be interacted with.
Curate Melita is a character in that is a part of the Ghosts of the Tribunal Creation Club content.
Curate Gadayn is a Dunmer residing at the Shrine of Azura in Vvardenfell, or in the Telvanni Peninsula.
Curate Erydno is a character residing in the Shulk Ore Mine in Vvardenfell. She leads the Nycotic Cult's activities there.
Dabienne Mornardl is a Breton who resides at the Mages Guild in Sadrith Mora's Wolverine Hall. She offers services to all, regardless of faction.

Daedroth are creatures encountered in . They are animalistic Daedra resembling large, bipedal alligator-like creatures. According to the book Darkest Darkness, they are minions of the Daedric Prince Molag Bal. According to the book Varieties of Daedra, they are "feral [and] beastlike" and "appear in the service of many different Daedric Powers, and may represent common creatures existing like wild animals in the wildernesses of Oblivion."

Dagail is the head mage of the Leyawiin Mages Guild. She is a Bosmer and the Master Mysticism trainer. She also provides the Leyawiin Recommendation, which is necessary for the Hero's entrance into the Arcane University.
Cyronin Sintav is an Imperial commoner located in the Imperial City. He is also one of four nephews of Iniel Sintav.
Cynric Endell is a Breton thief and a member of the Thieves Guild in Riften.
Cygwenn is a Bosmer bard performing in the Outside Inn in Elden Root.
Dacele Elve is a Breton mystic residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He owns Fog-Break Magicks and Arcana in the Merchant District, where he sells his wares.
Cynhamoth's Grove is a world boss location in the Fist of Stone region in the realm of Coldharbour. A Harvester named Cynhamoth resides here.
Dadazi is a Khajiit residing in the city of Silvenar. She is the wife of Buzul.
Daeril is a travelling Dunmer merchant. He was kidnapped by Worm Cult agents while on the road and brought to The Vile Pavilion.
Cyndassa of Daggerfall is a Breton maid in Castle Daggerfall, who is in service to the Queen Aubk-i.
Cyntoine Luluelle is a Breton member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Evermore.

Dablir is a Khajiit noble residing in Rawl'kha. He is one of the targets assigned by the Litany of Blood. He can be found walking on the path that circles the well in the center of the town or in the house next to the woodworking station. Like all targets, he has one white eye and must be killed with the Blade of Woe. He dissolves into a pool of blood when killed, though respawns almost immediately.
Daalinden is an Altmer found near the Plaza of the Eight in Shimmerene, Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.
Cylben Nadus is a Dunmer outlaw in who resides in Vulkwasten.
Daahin is a Khajiit zither-player residing in Rimmen. Other then the songs she continually sings, she has no dialogue.
Daedric Horse is a creature in / that is a part of The Cause Creation Club addon.

Dagoth Ur, known as Voryn Dagoth in life, Awakened Lord of the Sixth House, Lord Dagoth, and Father of the Mountain to his followers, and whom Vivec would later come to call The Sharmat, was a powerful Chimer lord and Lord High Councillor to House Dagoth, and is the main antagonist of . He is also called Devil Dagoth Ur or Devil of Dagoth.

Dagoth Gares was a member of the ancient Dunmer House Dagoth, and later head priest of House Dagoth's Ilunibi shrine. Whether Gares was ever a Dunmer is unknown, however he eventually became an Ash Ghoul through the power of Dagoth Ur, brought into the eternal service of Lord Dagoth.

Dagoth Morin was a Sixth House priest, apparently of some renown, who served Dagoth Ur during an unknown time. The details of Morin's life, including what type of Ash Creature he was, are shrouded in mystery. After his death, he was entombed deep beneath the House Dagoth base of Kogoruhn in the Bleeding Heart caverns. Dagoth Elam was set to guard the Tomb of Dagoth Morin, upon which rested the Shadow Shield an artifact which may have belonged to Morin in life. This shield would later be sought by the Nerevarine, who would fight to Morin's tomb to recover it.

Dagoth Girer is an Ash Ghoul and priest of House Dagoth during the Third Era. During the Vvardenfell Crisis, he was stationed at the Sixth House principal base of Kogoruhn. When the Nerevarine attacked the stronghold, he was forced to contend with Dagoth Girer in the Dome of Pollock's Eve, at which point Girer was most likely slain.
Dagoth Elam was an Ash Ghoul and Sixth House priest, during the Third Era.
Dagoth Uthol is a Dagoth, Heartwight, and a member of the Sixth House faction.
Danasi Ralen is a Dunmer commoner and member of House Redoran who resides in the Saren Manor within the Vivec, Redoran Canton.
Daren Adryn is a Dunmer Drillmaster who lives in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind. He is leader of the Camonna Tong in the village and can be found in Nadene Rotheran's Shack.
Daric Bielle is a Breton Hunter, and bounty hunter looking for an escaped Argonian slave. He is located at Desele's House of Earthly Delights in Suran and seems to be rather drunk.
Danus Artellian is an Imperial and the Guard Captain of the Skingrad Castle Guard. He sleeps in the Castle Skingrad Barracks and is not involved in any quests.

Damian Magius is a Breton commoner who works as a warehouse watchman for the Imperial Trading Company in the Imperial City Waterfront District. He can be found in the Imperial Trading Company Office, and sometimes goes to The Bloated Float for a two-hour lunch He wields a leveled mace and wears a Russet Felt Outfit with Pigskin Shoes.
